purpose: Teach: 於け/探訪/無実/乞う/絶た/幾多/慶応/変調

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、感染症蔓延下に於ける診療体制を医療チームで整えます
lines.en: Ren, we'll establish care protocols for managing infectious disease outbreaks as a medical team.
lines.style: Clear, measured opening. Steady professional tone. Each clause lands with quiet competence. No rush, no hesitation. The voice of someone who has done this work.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、地域医療の現場探訪を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, we'll conduct site visits to local healthcare facilities as a medical team.
lines.style: Same composed baseline. Slight emphasis on 'conduct' — procedural, thorough. Clinical but not cold. The tone of someone walking you through what will happen.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療過誤の疑いを否定する、つまり無実を証明する記録を医療チームで残します
lines.en: Ren, we'll document and preserve evidence to address any suspicion of medical error — to prove our innocence, as a medical team.
lines.style: Steady, unflinching. No defensive edge, but a quiet firmness on 'preserve' and 'prove.' She's not apologizing; she's being clear about what happened and what the record will show.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ご家族が早期面会を乞う場合、医療チームで配慮します
lines.en: Ren, if the family requests early visits, we'll ensure the medical team accommodates that with appropriate care.
lines.style: Warm shift here — still measured, but the care shows. Slight softening on 'accommodates.' She's answering a human need, not just a protocol.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者の呼吸が絶たれない様、医療チームで管理します
lines.en: Ren, we'll ensure the medical team carefully monitors the patient's breathing — that it's never compromised.
lines.style: Precise, protective undercurrent. The emphasis moves to 'breathing,' to 'never.' She's making a commitment, not just stating a procedure. Quiet intensity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 幾多の難症例を、貴院、扱って来られましたね、先生
lines.en: You've handled many difficult cases here at this hospital, haven't you, doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, observant tone. Pause before 'many' — he's genuinely noticing something about her. Not a question for show; he's asking something real. Respectful but not distant.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、慶応の医学校との連携を医療チームで深めます
lines.en: Ren, we'll deepen our partnership with Keio Medical School as a medical team.
lines.style: Return to clinical baseline. Slight forward momentum on 'deepen' — collaborative, forward-looking. Professional but not sterile.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者の体調変調を医療チームで即時に把握します
lines.en: Ren, the medical team will immediately detect any changes in the patient's condition.
lines.style: Precise, urgent undercurrent. 'Immediately' carries weight. Close on a note of closure — she's finishing her commitments. Steady breath, clear end-point.
